highlights.p: With an extensive network covering 99% of all U.S. ZIP codes, we provide reliable nationwide freight transportation through a single trusted source.
Customers, carriers, stakeholders, and partners expect best-in-class performance, which is why we actively listen, understand their needs, and consistently deliver with integrity.

lead.eyebrow: We are a leading LTL carrier
lead.title: Creating new ways to put your freight first
lead.text: For over a decade, we have led the way in brokered transportation, driving innovation across the industry by combining experienced professionals with cutting-edge technology. Our largest customers continue to choose us for our reliable service, strong capacity, and commitment to continuous improvement.

values.title: We've built an LTL network with national capacity, cutting-edge technology, and a world-class team, and we're continuously enhancing and expanding it.

items.p: We’re dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies and solutions that seamlessly connect customers and carriers with the right capacity, constantly looking forward to what’s next.
We understand that the success of our customers, carriers, and company rests in our hands. We are committed to solving problems and consistently exceeding expectations.

why.title: American Road Haul LLC proudly serves customers nationwide, delivering reliable freight transportation solutions with a focus on safety, efficiency, and exceptional service.

tabs.label: 24\7 Support
tabs.text: We are available to the driver around the clock. Because our team consists of daytime dispatchers, after-hours dispatchers, night dispatchers, weekend dispatchers. We have separate check callers, accounting department, safety department, eld department and fleet manager. We provide a full range of services at any time of the day or night.

tabs.label: Flexibility
tabs.text: Non-forced dispatch—run the days and lanes you choose. Daily or weekly settlements – provided on time, as expected. Opportunities for a variety of freight.

tabs.label: Personal Guidance
tabs.text: Responsive back-office services. Assistance finding the freight you want.

tabs.label: Best rates
tabs.text: Our Owners get only the best loads. For sure +20% of the market average.
